name: @tpmjs/tools-evals-blah
description: evals.blah.dev API tools — list models, evals, runs, results, leaderboard, and create models/evals/runs on the open LLM evaluation platform

env.name: EVALS_BLAH_API_KEY
env.description: API key from https://evals.blah.dev/settings/api-keys (starts with blah_). Required only for write operations (create model/eval, trigger run).

tools.name: listModels
tools.description: List all registered LLM models on evals.blah.dev with their name, inference URI, and metadata.

tools.name: getModel
tools.description: Get details of a specific model by ID on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: createModel
tools.description: Register a new LLM model on evals.blah.dev. Requires API key.

tools.name: getModelResults
tools.description: Get all eval results for a specific model on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: listEvals
tools.description: List all evaluation definitions on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: getEval
tools.description: Get details of a specific evaluation by ID on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: createEval
tools.description: Create a new evaluation definition on evals.blah.dev. Requires API key.

tools.name: listRuns
tools.description: List all eval runs on evals.blah.dev, newest first.

tools.name: getRun
tools.description: Get details of a specific eval run by ID on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: getRunResults
tools.description: Get all results for a specific eval run on evals.blah.dev.

tools.name: triggerRun
tools.description: Trigger a new eval run across all models and evals on evals.blah.dev. Requires API key.

tools.name: getResult
tools.description: Get a single eval result by ID on evals.blah.dev, including score, reasoning, and latency.

tools.name: getLeaderboard
tools.description: Get the model leaderboard ranked by average eval score on evals.blah.dev.
